# systeam_maintenance_window (Resource)

Manages a maintenance window.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_time` (String) End time in RFC3339 format.
- `name` (String) The name of the maintenance window.
- `start_time` (String) Start time in RFC3339 format.

### Optional

- `check_ids` (List of Number) List of check IDs included in the maintenance window.
- `description` (String) A description of the maintenance window.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the maintenance window is active.
- `is_recurring` (Boolean) Whether the maintenance window is recurring.
- `organization_id` (Number) Organization that owns the window. REQUIRED for non-superadmin callers; omit only for a superadmin platform-global window.
- `project_ids` (List of Number) List of project IDs included in the maintenance window.
- `recurrence_pattern` (String) Recurrence as JSON when is_recurring=true, e.g. jsonencode({type="weekly",days=[0,3],time="02:00",duration_minutes=120}). days: Mon=0..Sun=6.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone for the maintenance window.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the maintenance window.
